summary: Stage-2 AI Scene Planner retest. Re-ran the full existing backend suite (extended with 2 new scene-planning test files + 1 extended assertion) - 21/21 backend tests pass. Re-ran all 8 pre-existing browser checks by name (all pass; audio-playback-controls-timecode flaked once on a 1-frame race then passed on rerun - classified flaky, not a bug) plus rewrote the now-obsolete 'scenes-lane-empty-with-roadmap' check (the old stage-1 roadmap-items UI was replaced by the Analyze & Create Scenes button, per spec) and added 4 new browser checks for the scene planner UI. Regenerated /tmp/big-narration.wav which had been wiped from /tmp. No app bugs found; the AI-budget-exhausted honest-failure behaviour is confirmed working exactly as required.
action_items: Regenerated missing /tmp/big-narration.wav fixture (was wiped) so the large-file backend tests could run - infra housekeeping, not an app bug.

checks.criterion: Scene API returns the full structured plan for every scene
checks.name: test_scenes_endpoint_returns_full_structured_plan / test_project_scene_planning_subdocument_reflects_seeded_state
checks.evidence: GET /api/projects/{seeded id}/scenes -> 200, 8 scenes, each with all 16 required fields (start_time..asset_ids), scene_type in allowed set, asset_ids==[]; CHART scene has visual_search_queries==[]. GET /api/projects/{seeded id} -> scene_planning.status='ready', scene_count=8, model='SEEDED (not AI)'.

checks.criterion: Scenes render on the timeline lane and are visually differentiated by type
checks.name: scenes-timeline-and-list-render-8-types
checks.evidence: Navigated to /projects/{seeded id}: timeline-lane-scenes shows scene-block-0..7 all visible; scene-count-badge=='8 scenes'; scene-type-breakdown visible; scene-row-0..7 visible in the scenes list panel. Screenshot: scenes-timeline-and-list-render-8-types-scenes-lane-and-list-8-scenes.png.

checks.criterion: Each scene can be inspected and shows its entire visual plan
checks.name: scene-inspector-shows-full-plan-and-plays
checks.evidence: Clicking scene-block-0 opened scene-inspector with type/time/goal/transcript/queries/treatment/important-text/sfx/animation/transition all visible. Clicking scene-row-2 (CHART) showed scene-inspector-type containing 'chart' and scene-inspector-queries text 'generated, not searched'. scene-inspector-play-button moved timecode-readout off 00:00:00:00. 3 screenshots captured.

checks.criterion: 'Analyze & Create Scenes' is wired, guarded, and never fabricates scenes on failure
checks.name: test_replanning_real_project_ends_in_honest_failure_with_zero_scenes / scenes-failed-state-shows-error-banner
checks.evidence: Backend: POST /api/projects/{ElevenLabs id}/scenes/plan -> 202; polled until scene_planning.status=='failed' with non-empty error, scene_count==0; GET .../scenes==[]. Browser: /projects/{ElevenLabs id} shows scene-planning-error-banner, scenes-failed panel, non-empty scenes-error-text, scenes-lane-failed in the timeline, and analyze-create-scenes-button still present to retry.

checks.criterion: Planning endpoint guards wrong states with correct status codes
checks.name: test_plan_returns_409_when_transcription_not_ready / test_plan_returns_404_for_unknown_project / test_delete_scenes_returns_404_for_unknown_project
checks.evidence: Uploaded /tmp/speech23.wav and fired POST .../scenes/plan immediately -> 409 with non-empty detail (transcription not ready yet). POST .../scenes/plan on a random uuid -> 404. DELETE .../scenes on a random uuid -> 404.

checks.criterion: DELETE clears a plan so it can be re-run
checks.name: test_delete_clears_plan_then_restores_seeded_project
checks.evidence: DELETE /api/projects/{seeded id}/scenes -> 200 {ok:true, deleted:8}; follow-up GET .../scenes==[] and scene_planning.status=='idle'. Test restores the seeded plan in a finally-block via `python tools_seed_demo_scenes.py <id>` and re-asserts 8 scenes afterwards; confirmed intact post-suite via a separate curl (8 scenes present).

checks.criterion: FIXED BUG: a long transcript never shows a false 'No speech detected'
checks.name: large-transcript-no-false-empty-state
checks.evidence: Navigated to /projects/{ElevenLabs id, 112 segments} and polled every 150ms from first paint: transcript-empty was never visible; transcript-loading/transcript-list path resolved cleanly to transcript-list with transcript-count-badge=='112 segments' and matching transcript-segment- rows inside timeline-lane-transcript.
